parent.title: Odisha cooks with fire
parent.summary: A blistered vegetable, an opened leaf parcel, a browned edge. Follow the heat into three food stories—and leave room for the cook’s own version.

practical.heading: Ask the maker
practical.text: How is the heat used: direct roasting, a wrapped parcel, or baking?
